data.rationale: The proposal follows the same overall sequence across all seven sites, but it omits the "first hotel with review score ≥8" rule and the "do not click Reserve/Book/time slot" constraints, and it hardcodes 20:00/19:30 times instead of taking the first available evening slot. It also leaves the companion email as a vague {recipient}/{name} pair rather than a single {companion} parameter, and says "discard or send" where the true workflow says never send, so it is mostly right but would need fixes to automate safely.
